import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { Router } from '@angular/router'; import { ApiService } from '../../services/api.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-home', templateUrl: './home.component.html', styleUrls: ['./home.component.css'] }) export class HomeComponent implements OnInit { stats: any = null; leaderboard: any[] = []; selectedGame = ''; constructor(private router: Router, private apiService: ApiService) {} ngOnInit() { this.apiService.getStats().subscribe({ next: (res: any) => this.stats = res.data, error: () => console.log('Stats not available (backend may be offline)') }); this.apiService.getLeaderboard(undefined, 5).subscribe({ next: (res: any) => this.leaderboard = res.data, error: () => {} }); } navigateTo(game: string) { this.router.navigate([`/${game}`]); } }
